title: fix(setup): mute a not-running packaged flow's switch and say the scheduled-work policy plainly

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8L5cxFd5VXuXyEz4rkHiJ9G)_
Fixes #27378

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Setup › 打包自动化里,开关已开但引擎没有运行的流程,开关的「开」轨道改成灰色;因部署策略不运行定时任务的那一行,徽标换成一句白话「已启用，但此部署不运行计划任务」(十种语言)。
- 为什么改:原来绿色轨道让管理员以为流程在跑,而唯一的解释藏在 Details 里、还点名一个浏览器里改不了的环境变量。
- 风险与回滚:只改外观和文字,开关仍可点、仍写入启用标志,服务端原句仍在 Details 后面;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedAutomationPage.tsx`(Activation 单元格那段)、`PackagedAutomationPage.test.tsx` 第 7 节、`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` 新 key。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedAutomationPage.test.tsx`,预期 31 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

On Setup › Packaged automation, the Activation cell of a flow whose activation flag is on but which the engine has not armed (the row carries an `unboundCause`):

- **Muted on-track.** The switch gets `data-[state=checked]:bg-muted-foreground/60`, the same muted fill Studio's Automations pillar uses for an on switch it cannot flip (#27376, merged). `cn()` inside the `Switch` primitive drops the primitive's `data-[state=checked]:bg-primary` for it. Only the colour moves: the switch stays enabled, `checked` stays `row.enabled`, `aria-checked` stays `true`, and toggling still writes the flag (the ruling kept from objectui#13159).
- **Plain words for `deployment_policy`.** A row whose `unboundCause` is `deployment_policy` reads "On, but this deployment does not run scheduled work" in place of the badge, as a muted text line rather than a badge, because the badge is `whitespace-nowrap` and the sentence would overflow the 220px column. New key `packagedAutomation.notRunningDeploymentPolicy` in all ten locale packs, as `packagedAutomation.notRunning` is. The server's reason sentence is not rewritten: it stays verbatim behind the Details chip (`ReasonDetails`).
- **Unchanged.** Rows with `disabled_subflow`, `missing_trigger` or `binding_failure` keep the outlined "Not running here" badge. Running rows keep "On" on the primary track; off rows keep "Off".
- Doc comments in `PackagedAutomationPage.tsx` and `packagedFlows.ts` that said the page reads `unboundCause` "for presence only" / "no cause is told apart" now say which cause is told apart and why.

## Why

HotCRM's 18.2.0 browser pass (row 3 of #27356): five scheduled flows each showed a green On switch beside "Not running here", and the only explanation was the platform sentence naming `OS_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULED_WORK_ENABLED`, which an administrator cannot act on from the browser.

## Tests

`PackagedAutomationPage.test.tsx` section 7 (the Activation cell), beside the existing pins:

- acceptance: a `deployment_policy` row's switch is checked, `aria-checked="true"`, enabled, carries the muted track and not the primary one; the cell reads the plain line and does not contain the variable name;
- Details on that row still opens the platform sentence verbatim;
- CONTROL: bound, no-trigger and off rows keep the primary track class and "On" / "On" / "Off";
- CONTROL: `binding_failure`, `disabled_subflow` and `missing_trigger` rows keep "Not running here" (one badge class), with a muted track; none is destructive or an alert;
- CONTROL: the switch on a not-running row is muted and still toggles and writes `{ enabled: false }`;
- the existing re-read-after-toggle pin now expects the plain line for the policy row.

Four existing section 7 assertions pinned "Not running here" on a `deployment_policy` row; they now pin the plain line, which is this card's intended change.

## Acceptance notes

- The plain line is keyed on the closed `unboundCause` value, never on the reason sentence, which stays rendered and not parsed.
- `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` warns on the page's existing load effect (`setLoadError(null)`); it predates this diff and is untouched.
